Messages.Author: Mike Nudd
Messages.Body:
The previous questions here on the groups have reminded me about
another query I had:

- Bleeding minion A is blocked by minion B
- Combat occurs between minion A and minion B
- Minion C plays Fast Reactions to enter combat with minion A

If minion C has a ready Sniper Rifle, can the 'set range' ability of
the weapon be used or not? I'm guessing maybe not as minion C probably
isn't considered a 'blocking' vampire?

Regards,

Mike Nudd
VEKN Prince of London
mi...@vekn.org.uk
www.vekn.org.uk

>

> - Combat occurs between minion A and minion B
> - Minion C plays Fast Reactions to enter combat with minion A
>
> If minion C has a ready Sniper Rifle, can the 'set range' ability of
> the weapon be used or not? I'm guessing maybe not as minion C probably
> isn't considered a 'blocking' vampire?

B is still the blocking vampire, right.

But Sniper Rifle can only be used in the combat resulting from the block
[LSJ 18-AUG-2001], in any event.
